model_annotation: This plot illustrates the coverage of different llama models as a function of the number of completions (k). The x-axis is linear and ranges from 20 to 28, with tick labels spaced by increments of 1, and units of ‘k’ are indicated. The y-axis is linear and ranges from 0.78 to 0.8, with tick labels spaced by increments of 0.02. A solid blue line represents Llama-3B, starting at approximately 0.78 at k=20 and increasing to approximately 0.8 at k=28. A dashed green line represents Llama-3B + FT, beginning at approximately 0.42 at k=20 and increasing to approximately 0.68 at k=28. A solid light blue line represents Llama-1B, starting at approximately 0.6 at k=20 and increasing to approximately 0.78 at k=28. A dotted light green line represents Llama-1B + FT, beginning at approximately 0.4 at k=20 and increasing to approximately 0.6 at k=28.
